task_details.task_name: Top 5 spending customers with assigned support rep
task_details.prompt_description: List top 5 spending customers with their total invoice amount and assigned support representative's full name.

Zero Context.sql_query:

            JOIN invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

            JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
            JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
